## What is the AI zombie trend?

The AI zombie trend — also called the zombie love story or zombie hug — is a short AI-generated video that took off on TikTok and Instagram Reels in late September 2026. In the story, someone you love has turned into a zombie. The survivor hesitates, the zombie comes close, and the scene hard-cuts to a warm memory of the two of you.

Each video is a short story generated by AI from two photos, with a hard cut from a tense standoff to a warm memory. Everyone in your photos must be you or an adult who agreed to appear. No celebrities, public figures, minors or strangers.

Most people make it with a CapCut or Dreamina template, or by pasting a long prompt into a video model like Seedance or Kling. Zombie AI does the whole story for you from two photos — no prompt, no editing.

The format keeps spreading because the setup is simple and the ending is emotional: a cold standoff turns into a warm memory. Creators swap in adult loved ones, then choose a memory scene that feels specific to them.

The strongest versions use clear face photos, a quiet first scene and a final cut that looks personal instead of generic. That is why the zombie love story trend works better as a short custom video than as a one-size-fits-all effect.

No. The whole story - the standoff, the turn, the embrace and the cut to a sunny wheat-field memory - is already built into Zombie AI. You only upload two photos and pick a format.

Yes, every video comes with sound. You can also mute it and add the trending sound in TikTok or Instagram before posting.
